source.handler_routes: seven authored Action families / 16 routes; see action registry

success.summary: Action reports success, not exhaustive evidence coverage

partial.summary: Some result may be usable, but explicit partiality must be retained

not_implemented.summary: No implemented route; never imply invocation succeeded

invalid_input.summary: Invalid, denied or conflicting inputs; do not auto-correct silently

unavailable.summary: Insufficient evidence, external prerequisite, or handler exception

exit_code_semantics.scope: Process exit from scripts/ces.ps1 Finish, not this Python consumer's exit
exit_code_semantics.binding_or_host_failures: PowerShell binding or host errors before Finish may lack an envelope or use other exit codes

consumer_tool_exit_codes.0: wire shape and supplied exit code consistent
consumer_tool_exit_codes.2: I/O, JSON parse, or consumer tool error

json_text_difference.json_stdout: R150 Finish intends one compressed JSON object; handlers/native PowerShell not run here
json_text_difference.text_stdout: human-readable summary; no machine-readable coverage/evidence guarantee
json_text_difference.important: Some failures before script execution may be native PowerShell errors, not a CES envelope

identity_semantics.action: request Action string (not an action handler receipt)
identity_semantics.product_version: runtime CLI embedded version, not construction ZIP version
identity_semantics.build: runtime CLI embedded build, not construction R156
identity_semantics.next_step: R150 New-Envelope initializes 'none' and authored handlers do not assign another value; not a Cycle scheduler
identity_semantics.read_only: false on CodeSave merely identifies a potentially writing handler; does not prove persistence or authorization
identity_semantics.reason_code: handler/branch-specific diagnostic; never infer success from a reason prefix
identity_semantics.data: opaque per-action payload; preserve nested CodeShow Sequence k1..56 unchanged
identity_semantics.evidence: raw handler-supplied entries, no independent verification by contract consumer
identity_semantics.warnings: array of human-facing diagnostic strings, not a substitute for reason/status

coverage.summary: Flags describe only what the response asserts was checked/verified/authorized/materialized; mix of probes and outcome bits. Never use count of true fields as quality or completeness score.
coverage.extra_flags: allow JSON boolean extensions but explicitly label unrecognized
coverage.missing_baseline_field: contract violation for this R150-derived envelope
